Game Features
Multiple challenging environments and a variety of enemies, including demons and clones.
Players can choose weapons to fight the enemies.
Game modes:
Retribution Mode: Fight through eight fully playable stages, each with several locations and a boss at the end of each stage.
Survival Mode: Unlocked after completing Retribution Mode. Battle through eight challenging locations with very difficult enemies.
Disco Kombat: A disco arena battle mode unlocked after Retribution Mode. Features nearly all enemies from the game, including those who don't appear in the main stages.
Story The Dark Kingdom demons, led by the powerful sorcerer Apsu, open portals of dark energy to invade Crystal Tokyo. However, one of the portals accidentally opens in the Hundred Acre Wood, transporting Winnie-the-Pooh and his friends to Crystal Tokyo. Confused and attacked by the Sailor Senshi, who mistake them for Dark Kingdom demons, Pooh and his friends flee to the sewers. Under Rabbit's leadership, they devise a plan for revenge.
Using junk found in the sewers, they build a clone machine and, with the help of the Dark Kingdom demons, empower their clones with invincible dark power. The clone army, united with the demons, becomes a serious threat, setting out to conquer the city. The player's decisions will determine who will be the final victor!
